The line `const max = config.rateLimit.maxRequests || 10;` - the config properly provides `maxRequests: 100`, so this resolves to 100. If the config had been using a different property name (like `max` instead of `maxRequests`), `config.rateLimit.maxRequests` would be `undefined`, and the `|| 10` fallback would kick in, limiting users to 10 requests instead of 100. That matches the symptoms described ("some users can make unlimited requests while others get rate-limited after just 10 requests").
